---
name: Reproducible bug
about: Report a failure using synthetic input and a pinned candidate
---

## Environment
OS/architecture, Python/Node versions, artifact SHA-256 or commit, profile/version:

## Reproduction
Exact command and smallest synthetic input. Remove keys and private paths/data.

## Expected and observed behavior
Include response kind, error code and request ID. Keep unknown distinct from infeasible.

## Installation or download issue
First failing step, HTTP status (if relevant), and whether the complete provided
link was used. Do not paste a protected invitation URL or credentials.

Security reports must use the private process in SECURITY.md.
